segments.name: Refining
segments.description: Runs the company's petroleum refineries, markets refined petroleum products, and provides logistics assets that support those operations.
segments.evidence: our Refining segment, which includes the operations of our petroleum refineries, the associated activities to market our refined petroleum products, and the logistics assets that support those operations

segments.name: Renewable Diesel
segments.description: Produces low-carbon fuels through the DGD joint venture and markets renewable diesel, renewable naphtha, and neat SAF.
segments.evidence: our Renewable Diesel segment, which includes the operations of DGD and the associated activities to market low-carbon fuels

segments.name: Ethanol
segments.description: Operates ethanol plants and sells ethanol and co-products, including distillers grains, to customers.
segments.evidence: The principal products manufactured by our ethanol plants are ethanol and distillers grains.

revenueModel.text: Customers pay for refined petroleum products, renewable diesel, renewable naphtha, neat SAF, ethanol and distillers grains sold in the U.S., Canada, the U.K., Ireland and Latin America.
revenueModel.evidence: We are a multinational manufacturer and marketer of petroleum-based and low-carbon liquid transportation fuels and petrochemical products, and we sell our products primarily in the United States (U.S.), Canada, the United Kingdom (U.K.), Ireland, and Latin America.

changes.text: In 2025 the company approved a plan to idle its Benicia Refinery and cease refining operations by April 2026.
changes.evidence: In March 2025, we approved a plan with respect to the operations at our Benicia Refinery and currently intend to idle the processing units and cease refining operations by the end of April 2026.
